line: Tell a long-time friend why you've kept them close.
paragraph: An Irishman lost his wedding ring in a mountain stream while on vacation in Italy. Three young men who loved The Lord of the Rings heard about it and came to help. They searched the cold water for days, refusing to give up on the golden band he had called his 'precious.' When they finally found it, they did not mail it. They drove the ring to his home and returned it into his hands. He had his treasure back because three strangers decided his loss mattered to them.
